senses.gloss: m.(b. h. גִּר; גרר or גור to boil, effervesce, v. H., v. H. Dict. s. v.)

units: Sabb. 80ᵇ ביצת הג׳ Ar. (ed. הסיד), v. בֵּיצָה.—Denom. גִּיֵּיר to plaster.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:8">Lam. R. to IV, 11</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>סייד</he>).—
<cite ref="Chullin 88b">Ḥull. 88ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הג׳ והזרניך</he> quot. in Rashi to <cite ref="Exodus 16:14">Ex. XVI, 14</cite> (ed. only <he>הז׳</he>) powdered lime and orpiment.

Bets. 15ᵃ ביצת הג׳ a lump of ink-stone (for blackening leather).—In gen. powder, in compounds גִּירְגִּבְסִין powder of gypsum; גִּירְקְרָרִין wax dust, v. אַגֵּין. Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵇ bot. (perh. to be read in two words: lime, gypsum &c.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:7">Men. VIII, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 87a:2">87ᵃ</cite>) <he>זרק הג׳</he> (Mish. <he>ז׳ את הגיד</he>, corr. acc.) if the froth (of the fermenting wine) burst forth; Tosef. ib. IX, 11 <he>ג׳ של שמרים</he>.
